title: CLI contract X17c: inbox curation and cli-routing writers queue during a wave instead of refusing; gc takes a lease and skips live runs
summary: inbox edit, withdraw, verify, route-console and route-lane refuse while any run lease is live (refusedMidWaveAt, go/cmd/evolve/cmd_inbox_curate.go:25-35). cli-routing set|unset|init|migrate refuse too (go/cmd/evolve/boundary_write.go:13-27). gc has no top-level lease check (go/cmd/evolve/cmd_gc.go:23-50). Spec: docs/architecture/cli-contract.md §4 rules 2 to 4.
fix: During a live lease, a queued verb writes one request file under .evolve/queue/<verb>-<utc>.json and exits 4. The boundary applies the files in time order before sync-main and emits one cli.queue.applied signal each. Inside a phase pane the verbs still refuse with exit 3. gc takes the gc lease and skips each resource that a live run owns. Stage shadow for one wave, then enforce.
acceptance: The boundary step applies queued requests in time order and emits cli.queue.applied for each
In the shadow wave a queued verb still refuses as today and logs the request file that it would write; at enforce it writes the file and exits 4
A queued verb inside a phase pane (EVOLVE_DISPATCH_DEPTH>=1) still refuses with exit 3
TestGC_TakesItsLeaseAndSkipsLiveRuns proves gc leaves a live run's worktree and session alone
Changed functions at 100% coverage; cli-contract.md §4 and §5 and runtime-reference.md updated
